title: How Many Dudes? set to drop major new update and seven new dudes this month
summary: Having sold over 300,000 copies already across multiple platforms, developer Butterscotch Shenanigan's chaotic battle sim How Many Dudes? still isn't done answering just that question. In the new 1.1 update, arriving October 29th for all platforms, you'll have seven new dudes at your disposal, willing to throw their lives away battling all manner of strange opponents. If you're not already familiar, How Many Dudes? is based on the viral concept which asked people to propose how many regular people it would take to defeat a gorilla in hand-to-hand combat. Butterscotch Shenanigans took the concept even further, throwing not just gorillas, but wolves, gods and even bloodthirsty toddlers at you! ... [MORE]

title: Bills Must Be Paid, the piggy bank smashing sim, now has a release date for mobile
summary: Ready for a smashing good time? In Bills Must be Paid, the incremental game from developer Rike Games, you can do just that. Smash piggy banks to get cash, try not to tire yourself out, fail anyway and come back stronger (at least in the hand department). And now, Bills Must be Paid has confirmed its release for mobile on November 1st as a one-time $5.99 purchase! You may recall we covered Bills Must Be Paid a few weeks ago, and Tanish seemed to be enamoured with its curious mix of incremental game mechanics and Balatro-style roguelite progression. In Bills Must be Paid, the only objective is to keep smashing while watching your stamina, aiming to keep ahead of the ever-increasing costs as you harvest cash from smashed swine. ... [MORE]

title: Fortnite coming back to the iPhone App Store in Australia following another defeat for Apple
summary: After more than half a decade since it first started, the Apple v Epic saga is still grinding on, although now only in a very perfunctory manner. And the latest big defeat for the iPhone maker has been in Australia, where the courts have forced Apple to follow the example set by other markets and open its storefront to third-party apps. Of course, that also means Fortnite is now going to be available on iOS in Australia, officially, once more! This follows the change mentioned above, and the introduction of other shifts in policy, such as allowing alternative payment methods for in-app transactions, and whatnot. ... [MORE]

title: Playdigious announces iPhone Duo compatible games, including Subnautica and Planet of Lana
summary: The iPhone Duo is already making headlines around the world, both for good (the innovative design) and for bad (the massive price tag). But it's undoubtedly proving to be popular, with many owners now wondering which of their mobile games are compatible with the new device. A question Playdigious looks to answer. Playdigious have confirmed many of their mobile ports, including the likes of Subnautica, Don't Starve Together: Pocket Edition, 9 Kings, Planet of Lana and Evoland 2, will all be fully compatible with the iPhone Duo and its dual-screen, folding design. This includes a revamped and optimised interface, meaning you hopefully won't miss out on any functionality. ... [MORE]

title: Kettle Street brings British life sim chaos to Android, complete with nosy neighbours and butties
summary: Three years of living in the UK has prepared me for a worrying amount of Kettle Street. It’s a cosy British life sim out now on Android. Its furniture shop even leaves your deliveries with a neighbour as a matter of course, which is the most realistic thing I’ve seen in a life sim. You’ve just moved into a bare flat in a small town called Kettleby. Maureen at number 11 has already put the kettle on. From there it’s about finding work, paying your way and turning the place into a home one wage packet at a time. ... [MORE]

title: Mika: Dungeon Backpacker makes you pack the heroes’ bags before sending them into danger
summary: If I’m playing a game called Mika: Dungeon Backpacker, I’d expect her to be the hero of her own story. Except she really isn’t. She’s a Dungeon Supporter, which as far as I can tell means she packs everyone’s bags while four heroes take the credit. It’s a backpack-building roguelite with grid-based dungeons, and it’s coming soon to iOS and Android. The setting is Stonia, a continent that’s slowly turning into dungeons, and Mika’s latest job takes her into the ruins of a cathedral where an expedition disappeared a century ago. Something has been asleep down there ever since. Cheerful stuff. ... [MORE]

title: Legends of Amberland II brings its 90s-inspired RPG adventure to iOS and Android soon
summary: If you played Legends of Amberland on PC, you probably waited four years for a sequel. On phones, you’ll be waiting about eleven days. Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees is coming to iOS and Android, hot on the heels of the first game’s mobile release back in August. It’s another first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler built on 90s PC role-playing, so you’re moving square by square, turning in neat 90-degree steps, with a party of up to seven heroes. You can hand-pick their classes and races or take a pre-made group if you’d like to get going.  ... [MORE]

title: Bleach Mirrors High, the upcoming anime RPG, unveils its cast, including all-new original characters
summary: Like any good anime, Bleach by Tite Kubo has a cast that's as sprawling as its story. And now the upcoming mobile RPG Bleach Mirrors High has unveiled who'll be making the cut! But more interesting than just returning, familiar faces are the original suite of characters joining the lineup. In terms of returning cast members, the likes of Ichigo, Uryu Ishida, Rukia and Chad are all confirmed to appear, alongside many of Soul Society's finest (and Mayuri Kurotsuchi), as well as a dark horse addition with Bambietta Basterbine. It's particularly notable because Bleach Mirrors High is set in the aftermath of the Thousand-Year Blood War arc that saw Bleach roaring back to popularity. ... [MORE]

title: Astrae Oratio gets roaring approval from players after recent closed beta test
summary: It's rare for us to cover the results of a closed beta, and usually for good reason. It's a time when devs are still ironing out the kinks, and that means there are usually a few teething issues. But sometimes, things are so well received they can't help but crow about them, as Astrae Oratio's 93% approval rate shows. What that means is that, according to NCsoft, 93% of polled players in the closed beta for their upcoming magic-themed ARPG said they'd be playing on the official launch. 86% came away with an overall positive impression, and 80% singled out the world and its cast for praise. In total, players logged a combined playtime of over 80,000 hours in Astrae Oratio. ... [MORE]

title: Once Human lets you take to the seas in its Isles of Abyss update, out now
summary: What is it with this week and the ocean? Not only have we had Death in the Water 2 make its iOS debut, but we've also had Disney Dreamlight Valley's Keepsake Sea expansion get a major showcase! And now, in survival-shooter Once Human, you can take to the waves as part of its Isles of Abyss update! The headlining addition in Isles of Abyss is that of new naval options that allow you to make your way from simple sail-powered rafts all the way to massive battleships as you progress along a nautical tech tree. And you'll need that firepower as you explore five new hazard zones packed with danger and obstacles you'll need to tackle in order to unlock ways to resist them. ... [MORE]

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley unveils new look at its massive upcoming Keepsake Sea expansion
summary: During my time at Gamescom 2026, one of the more interesting appointments I had was with the folks at Gameloft to see their latest upcoming expansion for Disney Dreamlight Valley. Now, with its November 18th release just around the corner, we've had our best look yet at The Keepsake Sea! In a nearly 30-minute showcase, Gameloft unveiled more of the sea-themed expansion. That includes the appearances of a host of new characters, from Peter Pan's Wendy and Captain Hook to Pirates of the Caribbean's Jack Sparrow and both Atlantis' Milo Thatch and Hercules' Megara. All of whom will play key roles in the new storyline. ... [MORE]

title: Broken Ranks is a gritty MMORPG that plunges you into turn-based combat with 10 seconds to outsmart your enemy, now available on Android
summary: Whitemoon Games has unleashed a dose of old-school dark fantasy on mobile with Broken Ranks, an isometric MMORPG now available for Android. Blending the party-based adventuring of Baldur's Gate with tactical inspiration from Heroes of Might & Magic and Disciples, this free-to-play MMORPG looks to scratch that classic fantasy itch - and lop off a few limbs in the process! There's plenty of grim storytelling to get stuck into, too, with narrative-driven quests taking you across war-torn lands and into the unfortunate lives of the locals caught up in the chaos. You'll also have a classic roster of classes to choose from, with a mix of damage-dealers, archers, mages, and, the seldom seen but always appreciated, debuffer. ... [MORE]
